thread:
Mia: Quick sync — CloudHarbor's marketplace listing and joint integration webinar are locked for Apr 14. Need a launch plan: blog, benchmark narrative, webinar landing page, and inbound lead routing. Who owns what?
Jordan: I can own the webinar logistics + registration flow. Will set up GA + HubSpot tracking. ETA: draft registration page by Mon. :calendar:
Emily: I'll draft the blog + benchmark narrative. Thinking: 1) latency/cost comparison vs managed endpoints, 2) integration ease (plugin + demo), 3) customer quote from pilot. Need datasets and benchmark numbers from eng.
Saeed: I'll handle inbound lead routing and SDR handoff. Need UTM strategy and a webhook from the registration form to our /partners webhook. Also, can we tag leads by marketplace vs webinar?
Mia: Yes tag by source + partner. @Jordan please include hidden fields utm_source=cloudharbor_marketplace and utm_campaign=ch_integration_apr. Also we want source=marketplace on listing click and source=webinar on signups.
Jordan: Got it. I'll add hidden inputs and test with a staging webhook. Will post the registration snippet here.
marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar template slot reserved Apr 14 10AM PT. Links: <https://calendar.redwood/slot/414>
Emily: For benchmarks, can eng provide 3 workloads: chat latency (95p), tokens/sec for inference, and cost per 1k tokens for our recommended quantized recipe. Also need model variant names we'll recommend on the marketplace listing.
Alicia: Partner side can supply a customer success quote and a snippet about our joint integration flow. They want co-branded hero and a single CTA that either goes to marketplace listing or webinar reg depending on campaign.
Saeed: For routing: propose two HubSpot lists: CH_Marketplace_Clicks and CH_Webinar_Signups, then automations: Marketplace -> nurture 7 days -> assign to AE if engage; Webinar -> immediate follow-up email + invite to demo -> SDR tasks. Can add lead score + marketplace tag.
Mia: Perfect. Emily, try to keep the benchmark narrative short and visual — chart + 3 bullet takeaways. Also include a short 2-line technical appendix for the docs team.
Emily: Will do. Quick Q: do we want a pre-recorded demo or live panel for the webinar? Partner prefers live. Live gives Q&A but higher risk. Thoughts?
Jordan: Live panel with 20-min demo + 20-min AMA is good. We'll record and auto-send replay. I can recruit an SRE and product PM.
Mia: Go live. @Alicia confirm partner speakers and send headshots + bios by EOD Fri.
Alicia: Confirmed — partner PM + CS rep. Sending bios now.
Saeed: One more on attribution: when someone comes from the marketplace listing and then signs up for webinar, mark original source as marketplace and latest touch as webinar, funnel both to partner pipeline.
Mia: Yes — that's the attribution model. We'll capture both in hidden fields and pass to HubSpot.
Jordan: Posting the registration form snippet for QA: ```<form action="https://hooks.redwood/partners" method="POST"> <input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="cloudharbor_marketplace"/> <input type="hidden" name="campaign" value="ch_integration_apr"/> <input name="email"/> <button>Register</button> </form>```
Emily: Shared initial blog outline in google doc: 1) TL;DR + CTA 2) Integration overview 3) Benchmarks 4) How-to + appendix 5) CTA (marketplace + webinar). Link: docs.google.com/d/xyz
Mia: Great. Can we set a launch checklist? - Blog publish + marketplace listing sync - Webinar reg live + tracking - Partner assets uploaded - HubSpot lists + automations - AE/SDR playbook updated
Saeed: I'll draft the AE/SDR playbook and share by Wed. Includes talk tracks for marketplace inbound and webinar follow-up.
Jordan: I'll QA the form and test webhook on Tue and post results here.
Emily: I'll aim to have draft benchmarks and blog by Tue EOD for review.
Mia: Awesome team — thanks. We'll do a quick prep call Thu 9am PT to run through talk tracks and runbook. Please add agenda items to the calendar invite. :rocket:
